## Wi-Fi Connect 1.0.0

- The **Connect** shortcut now shows a native notification after a successful sign-in.
- The notification includes the connected Wi-Fi name and local time (`HH:mm`), matching the historical Windows toast format.
- Notifications continue to follow the setting in the desktop app.
- Settings can check the latest GitHub release and launch the matching system installer when a newer version is available.
- The app checks for updates about once a month and sends a native notification when one is available.
- Existing automatic reconnect schedules are refreshed on app startup so they use the installed app and current scheduler settings.

Installers are available for Linux amd64 (`.deb`), Windows x64 (`.exe`), and macOS Apple Silicon (`.dmg`). The macOS installer includes both the desktop app and the `wifi` CLI.
The release also includes a standalone macOS `.pkg` for in-app updates; the download page continues to offer the `.dmg`.
